title: Give items a priority and move the data file to version 2
goal: People mark what matters most, and no data file written by the version before is lost.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every item has a priority: low, normal or high. It can be given wherever an item is created or changed; any other value answers 400. An item created without one gets normal.

GET /todos takes priority=low|normal|high as one more filter, combined with the others; another value answers 400. GET /summary gains high_open: the number of items that are not done and have priority high.

The data file is written as version 2, with the priority of each item. A version 1 file still loads: its items get priority normal, and the file itself is left as it is until the next change is saved.

A file that is neither version 1 nor version 2, and a version 2 file with an item whose priority is missing or not one of the three, is refused like any file that cannot be read: StorageError, nothing written, the file left as it is.
README.md describes the priority, the filter, high_open and the version 2 file.

context.notes: High risk: this changes the file people keep their data in. Keep the exports of src/storage.mjs (parse, serialize, persist, StorageError, VERSION). Keep node:http only; no dependencies.
